Package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.effects.characters

package it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.effects.characters
Character Effects (Hunter, Constructor, Shaman and the passive ones: Artist/Inventor/Gatherer). They apply their immediate bonus at the moment the player purchases the card.
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    CharacterConstructor
    Constructor's effect: upon purchase, increases the player's permanent discount on buildings by a value equal to the card's level.
    CharacterHunter
    Hunter's effect: upon purchase, provides food equal to the number of hunters already owned by the player (including the one just picked).
    CharacterPassive
    "Passive" effect shared by Artist, Inventor, and Gatherer: they produce nothing upon purchase, they only count as statistics for endgame scoring and events.
    CharacterShaman
    Shaman's effect: upon purchase, provides magic points equal to the card's level.
